title: Wheat & Whimsy
body:
Modpack WIP – 1.21.5 Vibes Incoming!

Hey! Just putting together a little modpack project for 1.21.5—still a work in progress but already shaping up to be something special. It’s a mix of whimsy, chill exploration, and just the right sprinkle of magic.

Big shoutout to all the amazing mod creators out there—this wouldn't be possible without your work. Extra love to the artist(s) behind Of Whimscape—those textures are dreamy and completely set the tone. And major thanks to the creator of the Mellow shader too, it gives everything that soft, storybook glow I was hoping for.

Expect good vibes, cozy nights, and maybe the occasional cursed mushroom. More soon! 💜
